blocks.en: 1  Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Image restoration (IR) is a classical yet challenging research problem. Early IR research mainly focuses on a specific type of degradation, such as denoising [ 1 , 2 ] , deblurring [ 3 , 4 ] , super-resolution [ 5 , 6 ] , dehazing [ 7 , 8 ] , etc. Later, many all-in-one [ 9 , 10 ] or multiple-in-one [ 11 , 12 ] IR methods have been proposed, aiming to train a unified model to handle different types of image degradations. However, most of these methods still assume that the input image is corrupted by one single type of degradation, and they explicitly or implicitly recognize the degradation before restoring the desired image. In practice, however, captured images in real-world are often corrupted by complex, mixed degradations that cannot be modeled by a specific degradation type.
blocks.zh: 图像还原(IR)是一个古典而具有挑战性的研究问题. 早期的IR研究主要以特定类型的降解为主,如去诺化[1,2],去污化[3,4],超解[5,6],去污[7,8]等. 后来,许多全能[9,10]或多能[11,12]IR方法被提出来,目的是训练一个统一的模型来处理不同类型的图像退化. 然而,大多数这些方法仍然假设输入图像被一种单一类型的退化所腐蚀,在恢复所期望的图像之前,它们明示地或暗示地承认退化. 然而实际上,在现实世界中被捕获的图像往往被复杂而混合的退化所腐蚀,这些退化无法被特定的退化类型所模型.

blocks.en: Inspired by the recent rapid development of agentic models in multimodal understanding and generation [ 13 , 14 ] , agentic IR methods [ 15 , 16 ] have been proposed to address the issue of complex mixed degradations, where pretrained task-specific IR networks are exposed as restoration tools , and vision-language models (VLMs) are employed as the perceiver to assess image content and its degradations, map the identified degradations onto specialized IR models, and as the planner to schedule them into an execution sequence, frequently augmented with reflection, rollback, and rescheduling. However, this formulation is subject to fundamental limitations. First, it approximates coupled mixed degradations as a sequence of specialized restoration operations, whereas many real-world degradations interact and cannot be cleanly separated or reversed in sequence. Second, the planner converts fine-grained description of image content and degradation from the perceiver into a sequence of restoration tool calls, so much useful information is lost before restoration. Third, task-specified IR tools generalize poorly, limiting the overall generalization ability of the whole system. Last but not least, most agentic IR methods are developed and evaluated on synthetic mixed degradations, whereas real-world degradations often interact with each other, making them difficult to simulate. Therefore, although these paradigms have achieved great progress, their generalization to real-world scenes remains limited.
blocks.zh: 在最近迅速发展多式联运理解和生成[13、14]的代理模型的启发下,提出了代理式IR方法[15、16],以解决复杂的混合退化问题,其中经过预先培训的针对特定任务的IR网络被暴露为恢复工具,并使用视觉语言模型(VLMs)作为感知器来评估图像内容及其退化,将所查明的退化映射到专门的IR模型上,以及作为计划者将其排入一个执行序列,经常被反射、回滚和重新安排。 然而,这一提法受到基本限制。 首先,它大致将混合退化作为一系列专门恢复行动,而许多现实世界的退化相互作用,无法清洁地分离或相继逆转。 其次,规划者将图像内容和退化的精细描述从感知器转换为一系列恢复工具调用,因此在恢复前丢失了很多有用的信息. 第三,任务专用的IR工具概括性差,限制了整个系统的整体通化能力. 最后但并非最不重要的是,大多数剂性IR方法都是在合成混合降解上得到开发和评估的,而现实世界的降解往往相互影响,使其难以模拟. 因此,虽然这些范式已经取得了巨大进展,但它们对现实世界的概括仍然有限.

blocks.en: Recently, generative multimodal foundation models (MFMs) [ 17 , 18 , 19 ] have advanced rapidly. Having been trained for image editing, these models demonstrate great potential for IR tasks in recent works [ 20 , 21 ] . Basically, MFMs treat IR as an editing problem: they accept the LQ image together with an instruction to accomplish the restoration task. Unfortunately, prompting MFMs naively often yields unsatisfying results, as illustrated in Fig. 1 and Fig. 3 , these models often over-generate, embellishing detail and repainting texts and image contents. However, we argue that this does not mean that MFMs cannot perform complex real-world IR tasks; the key lies in how we instruct them, together with additional tools, to execute IR tasks in appropriate steps, harnessing the strong generative and generalization capabilities of MFMs for high-quality, universal real-world image restoration (Real-IR).
blocks.zh: 最近,遗传性多模式基础模型[17、18、19]迅速发展。 在接受图像编辑培训后,这些模型在近期的作品中展现出IR任务的巨大潜力[20,21]. 基本上,MFMs将IR视为编辑上的问题:他们接受LQ图像并同时指示完成修复任务. 不幸的是,如图1和图3所示,天真地促使MFM产生的结果往往令人不满意,这些模型往往过于精致、装饰细节并重新油漆文本和图像内容。 然而,我们争辩说,这并不意味着MFM不能执行复杂的现实世界IR任务;关键在于我们如何指示它们,连同其他工具,以适当步骤执行IR任务,利用MFM强大的基因和通俗化能力来进行高质量,普遍的真实世界图像修复(Real-IR).

blocks.en: To this end, we present HarnessIR , an agentic framework for universal real-world IR by harnessing an MFM as the executor. HarnessIR is organized into five stages: perception and diagnosis, on-demand tool invocation, prompt composition, execution, and verification-driven refinement. One key distinction between our design and previous work is that HarnessIR schedules no restoration tools , and it performs restoration by MFM calls; however, it invokes auxiliary tools — OCR [ 22 ] , face detection [ 23 ] , depth estimation [ 24 ] , semantic segmentation [ 25 ] — which act as evidence providers for prompt composition rather than links in a restoration chain. As shown in Fig. 2 , the LQ image and the restoration requests are first passed to a VLM, which returns a diagnosis of the content and its degradations, along with a recommendation on which auxiliary tools to invoke. The system executes the plan and collects the resulting evidence, which is fed back to the VLM with the LQ input and the first-stage analysis. The VLM then composes a prompt that contains rich content and degradation information, as well as the gathered evidence rendered in language. The prompt and the LQ image are passed to the MFM executor, and the VLM then examines the output to determine whether the restoration is satisfactory and how to revise the prompt for re-execution. HarnessIR binds the MFM to what the given LQ image actually needs for restoration, eliciting the MFM’s restoration capability while regulating how far it can alter the input, so that degradations can be removed without changing the content.
blocks.zh: 为此,我们提出HarnessIR,这是利用MFM作为执行者的普遍现实世界IR的代理框架。 节奏 IR分为五个阶段:感知和诊断、按需取用工具、即时组成、执行和核查驱动的改进。 我们的设计与以前的工作之间的一个关键区别是,HarnessIR计划没有恢复工具,它通过MFM调用进行恢复;然而,它引用辅助工具——OCR[22],面相检测[23],深度估计[24],语义分解[25]——作为迅速构成的证据提供者,而不是恢复链中的环节. 如图2所示,LQ图像和修复请求首先被传递给一个VLM,它返回了对内容及其降解的诊断,同时建议哪些辅助工具可以引用. 系统执行计划并收集由此产生的证据,这些证据与LQ输入和第一阶段分析反馈到VLM. VLM然后构成一个包含丰富的内容和退化信息以及所收集的以语言提供的证据的提示. 即时和LQ图像被传递给MFM执行器,然后VLM检查输出,以确定恢复是否令人满意,以及如何修改再执行的即时. 节奏 IR将MFM绑定在给定的LQ图像实际需要的恢复内容上,引出MFM的恢复能力,同时调节它能改变输入的多远,从而可以去除降解而无需改变内容.

blocks.en: Using advanced MFMs such as Nano Banana 2 [ 17 ] and GPT-Image-2.5-Sunburst [ 18 ] as executors, HarnessIR handles image restoration remarkably well. On MiO100 [ 11 ] , a widely used synthetic mixed-degradation benchmark, HarnessIR surpasses existing all-in-one and agentic IR methods on almost every metric. On the more challenging real-world images captured with both single and mixed degradations, where many all-in-one and agentic IR methods fail outright, HarnessIR outperforms prior methods by a large margin. Our ablation studies attribute these restoration gains to the harness rather than the executor alone. Our contributions are summarized as follows:
blocks.zh: 使用高级的MFM,如Nano Banana 2[17]和GPT-Image-2.5-Sunburst [18]作为执行者,哈内斯 IR处理图像修复工作非常出色. 在被广泛使用的合成混合降解基准"MiO100 [11]"上,哈内斯IR在几乎每个公分量上都超越了现有的全能和正剂IR方法. 在以单一和混合降解方式获取的更具挑战性的现实世界图像上,许多一元和一元剂式的IR方法彻底失败,哈内斯IR比先前的方法大有改进。 我们的减肥研究将这些修复成果归结为被利用者,而不是单独执行者。 我们的贡献概述如下:

blocks.en: • We first identify the limitations in the previous agentic IR paradigms and propose moving the agent action primitive from restoration tool scheduling to MFM harnessing. • We then propose HarnessIR , an agentic framework that harnesses a single MFM as the restorer without using task-specific restoration models as tools. • Experiments show that HarnessIR reaches leading performance on the widely used MiO100 benchmark; more importantly, it restores real-world images with complex degradations significantly better than existing agentic IR methods.

blocks.en: 2  Related Work and Discussion
blocks.zh: 2 有关工作和讨论

blocks.en: All-in-One and Agent-based Image Restoration. Early IR research usually addresses a specific type of degradation in isolation, such as denoising [ 1 ] , deblurring [ 3 ] , super-resolution [ 5 ] , dehazing [ 8 ] , etc. Subsequently, many all-in-one and multi-in-one methods have been proposed to address different degradations using a unified network, such as contrastive degradation embeddings [ 9 ] , degradation-aware learnable prompts [ 10 , 11 ] , CLIP-based degradation cues [ 12 , 26 ] , and natural-language instructions [ 27 ] . However, most of these methods assume that the input LQ image still has a single identifiable degradation, which limits their performance in unconfined real-world scenes [ 28 ] , where the captured images are often corrupted by complex and mixed degradations. To handle mixed degradations, agentic IR [ 15 ] takes task-specific restoration networks as tools and plans a sequence of calls over them. Existing agentic IR systems differ mainly in the design of the sequence. One line of research searches the space of tool orderings and uses intermediate results to update the plan [ 29 , 15 , 16 ] . Another line of work constrains the plan using degradation priors, staged decomposition, or complexity-based routing [ 30 , 31 , 32 ] . The third line learns the policy directly via reinforcement learning using perceptual or no-reference quality rewards [ 33 , 34 , 35 , 36 ] . In all these paradigms, the tools are task-specific restoration networks, which are also executors. Consequently, their generalization performance is bounded by these tools, which work poorly under complex, out-of-distribution real-world degradations.
blocks.zh: 全能一并代理图像还原. 早期的IR研究通常针对隔离状态下的特定类型的降解,如去诺化[1],去污化[3],超解[5],去污[8]等. 随后,提出了许多全一和多一方法,用一个统一的网络来解决不同的降解问题,例如对比性降解嵌入[9],降解感可学习的提示[10,11],基于CLIP的降解提示[12,26],以及自然语言指令[27]. 然而,这些方法大多假设输入的LQ图像仍然具有单一可识别的降解性能,这限制了其在无限制现实世界场景中的性能 [28] 被捕获的图像往往被复杂而混合的降解性所腐蚀. 为了处理混合降解,代理IR[15]将针对特定任务的恢复网络作为工具,并计划对其进行一系列呼叫。 现有的代理IR系统主要在序列的设计上有所不同. 一行研究搜索工具订购的空间,并使用中间结果来更新计划[29,15,16]. 另一行工程使用降解前序,相相相分解,或基于复杂性的路由[30,31,32]来制约计划. 第三行直接通过强化学习来学习政策,利用知觉或无参考质量奖励[33,34,35,36]. 在所有这些范式中,这些工具都是针对特定任务的恢复网络,这些网络也是执行者. 因此,这些工具限制了它们的通融性能,而这些工具在复杂、分散、实际世界退化的情况下运作不良。

blocks.en: Multimodal Foundation Models (MFMs). Generative MFMs [ 19 , 37 , 18 ] and their instruction-based editing interface allow a single model to perform an open set of pixel-level operations specified in language. Since restoration can be phrased as an editing instruction, researchers have begun to examine MFMs for IR. [ 20 ] evaluated Nano Banana 2 [ 17 ] as a unified restorer. While the perceptual results are appealing, it over-synthesizes many unfaithful details. Similarly, [ 21 ] prompted MFM with fixed instructions and found that the fidelity of the image is difficult to preserve. However, we argue that this does not mean that MFMs lack the capability for performing faithful Real-IR. The key lies in how we prompt them. With an appropriate harness to elicit and utilize their capabilities, the MFMs can significantly improve perceptual quality while preserving image content.
blocks.zh: 多式联运基础模型。 Generative MFMs [19, 37, 18] 及其基于指令的编辑界面允许单个模型执行语言所指定的一组开放式像素级操作. 由于修复可以被短语为编辑指令,研究人员已经开始为IR检查MFM. [20]评价"纳诺香蕉2"[17]统一恢复. 虽然知觉结果很有吸引力,但它过度综合了许多不忠实的细节. 同样地,[21]用固定的指示促使了MFM,并发现图像的忠诚性难以保存. 然而,我们争辩说,这并不意味着MFM缺乏履行忠实的Real-IR的能力. 关键在于我们如何激励他们。 通过适当的手段来吸引和利用它们的能力,MFM可以在保存图像内容的同时大幅度地提高知觉质量。

blocks.en: Harness: From Foundation Models to Agentic Systems. An MFM is not by itself an agent. What turns it into an agentic system is the harness [ 38 ] , which includes the prompts and control flow that frame the task [ 39 ] , the tools that collect evidence [ 40 ] , the verification logic that decides when an output is acceptable [ 41 ] , and the memory if needed [ 42 ] . With an appropriate harness, the base MFM can become a markedly strong agent depending on what is wrapped around it [ 38 , 43 ] . Our proposed HarnessIR is a different yet much more effective instantiation for agentic IR: it diagnoses before acting, calls auxiliary tools for evidence, explicitly constrains what should be restored, and employs a verifier to decide whether to try again based on the current results.
blocks.zh: 利用:从基础模型到代理系统. MFM本身不是代理人。 将它变成一种代理系统的是用具[38],它包括设定任务的提示和控制流[39],收集证据的工具[40],决定某项产出何时可以接受的核查逻辑[41],以及必要时的内存[42]. 有了适当的绳索,基础MFM就能够成为显著的强力剂,取决于它周围的包裹[38,43]. 我们提出的策略 IR是对代理IR的一种不同而更有效的即时反应:它在行动前进行诊断,调用辅助工具作为证据,明确限制应该恢复的东西,并使用一个核查员来决定是否根据目前的结果再次尝试.

blocks.en: We use five stages to achieve our goal, as illustrated in Fig. 2 (b). We instantiate the diagnoser, composer, and verifier using the same frozen vision-language model (VLM) [ 44 ] with three role-specific briefs. The diagnoser 𝒱 d \mathcal{V}_{d} produces a diagnosis d d of image content and degradations, together with a plan π ⊆ 𝒯 aux \pi\subseteq\mathcal{T}_{\mathrm{aux}} specifying what auxiliary tools to consult. After the planned tools return evidence e e , the composer 𝒱 c \mathcal{V}_{c} writes p p from ( x , r , d , e ) (x,r,d,e) ; the executor ℰ \mathcal{E} produces y ^ \hat{y} ; and the verifier 𝒱 v \mathcal{V}_{v} decides whether the result is accepted and which candidate is retained. Diagnosis and composition are separated because the final instruction can only be written after the diagnoser selects the tools and the requested evidence has been acquired. HarnessIR focuses on how to construct an image-specific instruction and how to verify and re-execute. In the following sections, we describe its evidence collection, prompt composition, and failure-triggered refinement in detail.

blocks.en: 3.2 What is Planned: Evidence to Gather, Not Restorers to Run
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 计划是什么: 收集证据, 而不是恢复器

blocks.en: HarnessIR plans over a different space from previous agentic IR methods [ 15 , 30 ] , which search over orderings of restoration networks to decide how the image will be processed. Instead, HarnessIR plans what the system should perceive before writing p p . The set of auxiliary tools — text recognition, face detection, depth estimation, and semantic segmentation — supplies observations that the executor would not otherwise seek on its own. For a capable MFM, the simpler the prompt it is given, the more freely it follows its own prior, which may result in hallucinations for restoration. The evidence and the instructions elicit what the executor should do to reduce the possibility for hallucination.
blocks.zh: 节奏 IR计划与以前的代理IR方法[15,30]不同的空间,这些方法在命令恢复网络时进行搜索,以决定如何处理图像. 相反,哈妮丝 IR 计划系统在写 p. 这套辅助工具——文字识别,面相检测,深度估计和语义分解——提供了执行者原本不会自行寻求的观察. 对于一个有能力的MFM来说,它给出的快取越简单,它就越自由地遵循自己的先取,这可能导致恢复的幻觉. 证据和指示引出执行者应如何减少幻觉的可能性.

blocks.en: The tools to consult are decided by the diagnoser that produces d d in the same call, rather than by fixed rules, because the decision depends on the content of the image: text recognition is worth running when legible text is present, and depth estimation is worth taking when the degradation is spatially structured. For images with simple contents and degradation, the tools may not need to be called. The invoked tools return raw, image-specific observations, e.g., recognized strings, confidences, and bounding boxes for texts; bounding boxes for faces; a dense depth map; and a segmentation map with semantic labels. These outputs are supplied directly to the composer in their native structured or visual forms, and they are not passed to the executor. A complete example is provided in Appendix A.2 .
blocks.zh: 咨询工具由在同一呼叫中生成dd的诊断器决定,而不是由固定规则决定,因为决定取决于图像的内容:文本识别值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值 对于内容简单和退化的图像,工具可能不需要调用. 被引用的工具返回原始的,图像特定的观测,例如,文本的识别字符串、信任和边框;面部的边框;密集的深度图;以及带有语义标签的分块图。 这些出品以原生结构或视觉形式直接提供给作曲家,而不会被传递给执行者. 附录A.2提供了完整的例子。

blocks.en: 3.3 What is Passed to Executor: Instruction Prompt, Not Execution Order
blocks.zh: 3.3 国家 传递给执行者的是什么:指令即时而非执行令

blocks.en: The diagnosis is expressed in language, while the evidence from the tool may be structured or visual. The composer interprets this evidence jointly with the LQ image rather than merely transcribing it, and converts the relevant observations into a single textual instruction. The evidence is folded into the image description rather than appended as a list, each piece tied to the content it describes and the degradation it bears witness to. For example, the haze is to be cleared more aggressively in the background than in the foreground, as the depth indicates. The composer decides whether to accept the evidence or weigh the evidence against the LQ input x x .
blocks.zh: 诊断用语言表达,而工具中的证据可能结构化或视觉化. 作曲家将这种证据与LQ图像一并解释,而不只是转录,还将相关观察转化为单一的文字指令. 证据被折叠入图像描述中,而不是作为清单附后,每块都与它描述的内容和它所见证的退化联系在一起. 例如,如深度所示,在背景中要比在前地更积极地清除烟雾。 作曲家决定是接受证据,还是根据LQ输入xx来权衡证据.

blocks.en: In addition, the composer’s role-specific brief includes general restoration requirements that encode domain knowledge about each restoration operation. For example, deraining and desnowing should remove falling rain and snow without removing wet roads or snow cover in the scene, while brightness should remain unchanged when low-light enhancement is not requested. The composer jointly considers the provided information and these requirements, retains only the applicable requirements, and rewrites them into an image-specific prompt p p . The executor receives only the LQ image x x and the composed prompt p p . Unlike prior agentic IR methods, which formulate their analysis as a list of task-specific restoration tools, HarnessIR embeds image-specific information into the prompt, including what degradations to treat, what content to preserve, and where these requirements apply. The complete brief of the composer is provided in the released codes.
blocks.zh: 此外,作曲家的角色特有简要说明中还包括一般的恢复要求,这些要求将每个恢复操作的域名知识编码. 例如,脱去和脱去应去掉落下的雨雪而无需去掉场景中的湿道或雪盖;而亮度在不要求低光增强时应保持不变. 作曲者共同考虑所提供的信息和这些要求,只保留可适用的要求,并把它们改写为图像专用的快取p. 执行器只接收 LQ 映像 x 和所构成的快取 p. 与先前的特异性IR方法不同,它将其分析制定为任务特定恢复工具的列表,哈内斯IR将图像特定信息嵌入到快件中,包括需要处理的降解,需要保存的内容,以及适用这些要求的地方. 作曲家的完整简况在所发行的代码中提供.

blocks.en: 3.4 When the Loop Fires: On Failure, Not by Design
blocks.zh: 3.4 国家 当循环起火: 失败时, 不按设计

blocks.en: HarnessIR is designed to succeed in one execution and invoke another round only when the verifier judges the result unsuccessful. The output is first measured using NR-IQA scores and inexpensive comparisons with x x , including brightness, color statistics, and SSIM between the output and the LQ input. These measurements provide diagnostic evidence rather than fixed acceptance thresholds: they are passed to the verifier together with x x and the output, and the verifier makes the final decision. The verifier carries the same restoration requirements as the composer and weighs the output against them, together with the request r r and the measurements. The instruction to the executor is not shown to the verifier so that the result is judged against what the restoration task is supposed to do rather than against the instruction we ask the executor to follow.
blocks.zh: 节奏 IR是为了在一次处决中取得成功,只有在核查者判断结果不成功时才能援引另一轮处决。 输出首先使用NR-IQA分数进行测量,并与xx进行廉价比较,包括亮度,颜色统计,以及输出和LQ输入之间的SSIM. 这些测量提供了诊断证据,而不是固定的接受阈值:它们与xx和输出一起传递给核查者,由核查者作出最后决定. 核查者与作曲者具有相同的还原要求,并对照他们权衡输出,连同请求r和测量. 对执行人的指示不向核查人显示,以便根据修复任务应做什么来判断结果,而不是根据我们要求执行人遵循的指示来判断。

blocks.en: HarnessIR starts over from x x , not the output of the last round as in previous agentic IR methods. This is because if the output of the last round is verified to be unsuccessful, the content of the image can be altered, such as incorrect text, fabricated structure, etc. Such an output is the wrong place to start from, while x x remains the safest input for the executor to start from. When the verifier calls for a redo, it writes down what should be corrected. The composer then writes a new instruction for the same x x , and passes it to the executor. The verifier also compares the new restoration result with the best candidate obtained in previous rounds and retains the better one as y ^ \hat{y} . We allow at most three execution rounds; if no candidate is accepted by then, the best candidate selected by the verifier is returned. The complete verifier prompts are provided in the released codes.
blocks.zh: HarnessIR从xx开始,而不是像以前的代理IR方法那样输出上一轮. 这是因为如果最后一轮的输出被证实不成功,图像的内容可以被更改,如不正确的文本,被捏造的结构等. 这样的输出是错误的起始地,而xx仍然是执行者最安全的起始地输入. 核查人要求重做时,写下应当改正的内容. 作曲家随后为同名xx写出一则新的指令,并传递给执行人. 核查员还将新恢复结果与前几轮获得的最佳候选人进行比较,并保留了优胜者为y^\hat{y}. 我们最多允许三轮处决;如果当时没有候选人被接受,则由核查员选出的最佳候选人被退回。 公布的代码中提供了完整的验证符提示.

blocks.en: 4.2 Evaluation Protocol and Metrics
blocks.zh: 4.2 评价规程和计量

blocks.en: Following prior works [ 15 , 21 , 45 ] , we measure fidelity with PSNR and SSIM [ 46 ] in the Y channel, perceptual quality with LPIPS [ 47 ] and DISTS [ 48 ] , and image quality with the no-reference image quality assessment (NR-IQA) metrics MANIQA [ 49 ] , CLIP-IQA [ 50 ] , MUSIQ [ 51 ] , TOPIQ [ 52 ] , and A-FINE [ 53 ] . However, it should be noted that a higher NR-IQA score does not, by itself, indicate better restoration performance because their purpose is to evaluate image quality without considering whether the restored content is correct or not. As a result, hallucination can be rewarded, even when the content of the restored image deviates significantly from the input LQ image. Fig. 3 shows some examples. We see that the restored images significantly outscore their GTs on NR-IQA metrics, while the image content and text have been largely repainted. Such cases are rare for earlier discriminative restoration networks, but can be common for diffusion-based generative models. This is because the generative methods are more prone to altering image content and NR-IQA metrics only measure whether the given image is of good quality, no matter what content it has.
blocks.zh: 继先前的作品[15,21,45]后,我们用PSNR和SSIM[46]在Y频道中测量忠诚度,用LPIPS[47]和DISTS[48]的感知质量,并用无参考图像质量评估(NR-IQA)度量的图像质量ManiQA[49],CLIP-IQA[50],MUSIQ[51],TOPIQ[52],A-FINE[53]. 然而,应当指出的是,较高的NR-IQA分数本身并不表明恢复性能更好,因为它们的目的是在不考虑恢复内容是否正确的情况下评价图像质量. 因此,幻觉可以得到奖励,即使恢复后图像的内容与输入的LQ图像有显著的偏差. 图3显示了一些实例。 我们看到,恢复的图像在NR-IQA度量表上大大超过其GT分数,而图像内容和文本基本上被再油漆. 这种案例对于早期的歧视性修复网络来说是罕见的,但对于以扩散为基础的基因模型来说可能是常见的. 这是因为基因方法更容易改变图像内容,而NR-IQA的度量标准只能衡量给定的图像是否质量良好,无论它有什么内容.

blocks.en: To solve this issue of unreasonable use of NR-IQA metrics in Real-IR method evaluation, we make two adjustments. First, when a GT exists, we report the absolute distance, denoted by Δ \Delta , between the NR-IQA scores of the restored image and the GT image. A value of Δ \Delta closer to zero means better quality since the GT is the target. Second, regardless of whether a GT exists, following recent IR and IQA works [ 54 , 55 ] , we use an independent VLM evaluator of the HarnessIR system to assess restoration performance directly. Given the LQ input and the restored output, it reports D-Score for degradation removal and F-Score for content preservation, both on a scale of 0 0 – 100 100 . For each image, we compute their geometric mean, DF-Score = D ​ F =\sqrt{DF} , which is high when both degradation removal and fidelity are good. The evaluator prompt and protocol, ablations, and comparisons with human judgments are provided in the Appendix C .

QQ\Delta的值接近于零意味着质量更好,因为GT是目标. 第二,无论是否存在GT,在最近IR和IQA作品[54,55]之后,我们使用哈内斯IR系统的独立VLM评价员直接评估恢复性能. 鉴于LQ输入和被恢复的产出,它报告D-Score用于去除退化,F-Score用于内容保存,两者的规模都是0–100. 对于每个图像,我们计算出它们的几何平均值 DF-Score = DF =\sqrt{ DF},当降解去除和忠诚都很好时,这个数值是很高的. 附录C提供了评估人员的及时性和协议性,与人类判断的比较性。

blocks.zh: 4.3 主要成果

blocks.en: Results on Synthetic MiO100 Test Sets. Tab. 1 summarizes the group-averaged results on MiO100 (detailed results of Group A, B and C are in Appendix D ). Compared with the direct-use baselines (Nano Banana 2 and GPT-Image-2.5), HarnessIR-NB2 and HarnessIR-GPT gain 1.40 1.40 and 1.75 1.75 dB in PSNR, improve LPIPS by 0.03 0.03 and 0.06 0.06 , and DF-Score by 4.1 4.1 and 18.1 18.1 points, respectively. These gains mainly reflect better content preservation. HarnessIR also substantially improves GPT-Image-2.5’s D-Score. For NB2, the D-Score changes only slightly because MiO100 is constructed by applying controlled synthetic degradations to curated GT images. NB2 can already remove these degradations effectively.
blocks.zh: 合成米O100的结果 Test Sets. Tab. 1总结了米奥100上的组平均结果(A组,B组和C组的详细结果见附录D.). 与直接使用基线(Nano Banana 2和GPT-Image-2.5)相比,哈内斯IR-NB2和哈内斯IR-GPT在PSNR中分别获得1.40 1.40和1.75 1.75 dB,将LPIPS分别提高0.03 0.03和0.06 0.06分,而DF-Score则分别提高 4.1和18.1 18.1分. 这些成果主要反映了内容保存的改善。 节奏 IR也大大地改进了GPT-Image-2.5的D-Score. 对于NB2,D-Score只稍有变化,因为MiO100是通过将受控的合成降解法应用到被曲解的GT图像来构建的. NB2已经可以有效去除这些退化.

blocks.en: Against prior methods, HarnessIR-NB2 achieves the best results on most metrics except SSIM and F-Score. HarnessIR-GPT achieves the best result on Δ \Delta TOPIQ. Several all-in-one models achieve relatively high F-Scores but D-Scores below 30 30 , suggesting that their fidelity comes partly from making only limited restoration changes. Although HarnessIR-GPT improves substantially over the direct use of GPT-Image-2.5, it is weak in PSNR and SSIM. This reflects the executor’s capabilities rather than a limitation of the harness: the harness helps to unleash the executor’s restoration potential but cannot raise its upper ceiling. GPT-Image-2.5 has a strong generative prior but tends to restore more aggressively, which makes its outputs less pixel-aligned with the GT.
blocks.zh: 与先前的方法相反,HarnessIR-NB2在除SSIM和F-Score以外的大多数度量衡上都取得了最佳成绩. HarnessIR-GPT在QQ\Delta TOPIQ上实现了最佳效果. 一些全能模型取得了相对较高的F-Score但D-Score低于30.30的成绩,这表明其忠诚程度部分来自仅进行有限的修复改变. 虽然HarnessIR-GPT在直接使用GPT-Image-2.5上有了很大的改进,但在PSNR和SSIM中却很弱. 这反映了执行者的能力,而不是对绳索的限制:绳索有助于释放执行者的恢复潜力,但不能提高上等上限。 GPT-Image-2.5 具有很强的先天性,但往往会更积极地恢复,这使得其输出的像素与GT相对应较少.

blocks.en: Results on Real-Paired-200 and Real-NoGT-200 Test Sets. The advantage of HarnessIR is even more pronounced on real-world data. On Real-Paired-200 (Tab. 2 ), both HarnessIR variants substantially improve their direct-use baselines in fidelity and restoration quality. HarnessIR-NB2 achieves a 2.69 2.69 dB PSNR gain and reaches a DF-Score of 62.0 62.0 , while HarnessIR-GPT improves PSNR by 2.87 2.87 dB and raises its DF-Score from 40.1 40.1 to 60.2 60.2 . HarnessIR also outperforms all prior methods by a clear margin in DF-Score, with both variants exceeding the previous best of 38.8 38.8 . HarnessIR-NB2 also achieves the smallest deviation from the GT on four of the five NR-IQA metrics. In particular, HarnessIR-NB2 achieves the highest PSNR, surpassing the best prior result by 1.76 1.76 dB. This is notable because the LQ input already reaches 25.27 25.27 dB; the high PSNR but low D-Scores of several all-in-one methods therefore likely reflect limited restoration, whereas HarnessIR-NB2 improves upon the input while maintaining strong degradation removal.
blocks.zh: Real-Paired-200和Real-NoGT-200测试集的结果. 哈内斯IR的优势在现实世界数据上更为显著. 在Real-Paired-200(第2段)上,两个HarnesIR变体都大大提高了在忠诚和恢复质量方面的直接使用基线。 HarnessIR-NB2实现2.69 2.69 dB PSNR增收并达到62.0 62.0分的DF-Score,而HarnessIR-GPT则将PSNR改进为2.87 2.87 dB并提高其DF-Score从40.1 40.1分提高到60.2 60.2分. 节奏 IR在DF-Score中也以明显的比值超越了所有先前的方法,两种变体都超过了之前的38.8 38.8.8. . HarnessIR-NB2在5个NR-IQA度量衡中的4个也实现了与GT最小的偏差. 特别是哈内斯IR-NB2取得了最高的PSNR,以1.76 1.76分贝的成绩超过了之前的最佳成绩. 这一点值得注意,因为LQ输入量已经达到25.27 25.27分贝;因此,几种全一方法的高PSNR-但分数低的D-分数可能反映恢复有限,而HarnesIR-NB2则在保持强烈降解去除的同时改进了输入量。

blocks.en: The results on Real-NoGT-200 (Tab. 3 ) lead to the same conclusion. HarnessIR substantially improves both D-Score and F-Score for the two executors, yielding DF-Scores of 62.9 62.9 for NB2 and 49.3 49.3 for GPT-Image-2.5. These scores are well above the best prior result of 32.0 32.0 . The lower NR-IQA scores of HarnessIR relative to the direct use of MFM should therefore not be interpreted as a decline in performance. As discussed in Fig. 3 , NR-IQA can reward hallucinated details even when the image content has been altered. We consequently use DF-Score for the no-GT setting, as it evaluates degradation removal and content preservation jointly.
blocks.zh: Real-NoGT-200(第3段)的结果得出了同样的结论. 节奏 IR大大改善了两个执行者的D-分数和F-分数,使DF-分数NB2为62.9 62.9分,GPT-Image-2.5为49.3 49.3分。 这些分数远高于32.0-32.0的最好成绩。 因此,与直接使用MFM相比,HarnessIR的NR-IQA分数较低不应被解释为性能下降. 如图3所讨论,NR-IQA可以奖励幻觉细节,即使图像内容被改变. 因此,我们使用DF-Score来设定无GT,因为它共同评价降解去除和内容保存。

blocks.en: Visual Results. Fig. 4 shows qualitative comparisons across the three test sets. The all-in-one methods make little visible improvement over the LQ inputs in these examples, with only PromptIR removing some of the snow in the third image. Previous agentic IR methods make the MiO100 image somewhat clearer, but produce only limited improvement on the two real-world images. In contrast, the MFM-based methods remove degradations more effectively. However, direct use of NB2 and GPT-Image-2.5 often alters image content. In the first example, HarnessIR better preserves the original color tone and scene content. In the second, both direct MFM baselines mistakenly remove the white cross already in the image, and NB2 also changes the text. In the third, both baselines turn the nighttime scene into daytime and remove the snow cover; GPT-Image-2.5 additionally makes the trees appear to have sprouted leaves. HarnessIR avoids these unwanted changes while still removing degradations, producing visually cleaner results that remain faithful to the original LQ images.
blocks.zh: 视觉结果. 发相. 4 显示三个测试组的质量比较。 全能方法与这些例子中的LQ输入相比几乎没有明显的改善,只有ExpoinIR去除了第三种图像中的一些积雪. 先前的代理IR方法使MiO100图像略为清晰,但只能对两个现实世界的图像产生有限的改进. 相反,基于MFM的方法可以更有效地去除降解. 然而,直接使用NB2和GPT-Image-2.5经常会改变图像内容. 在第一个例子中,HarnessIR更好的保存了原色调和场景内容. 在第二作中,两个直接的MFM基线都错误地去掉了已经存在于图像中的白色十字,而NB2也修改了文本. 第三,两个基线将夜间场景变为白天并去除雪盖;又使GPT-Image-2.5使树木显得有出花叶. 节奏 IR避免了这些不想要的改变而同时仍然去除降解,产生仍然忠于原始LQ图像的视觉更清洁的结果.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Visual comparisons on three test sets. HarnessIR achieves better fidelity and visual quality.
blocks.zh: 图4:三套测试的视觉比较。 节奏 IR实现了更好的忠诚和视觉品质.

blocks.en: 4.4 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 4.4 阅读研究

blocks.en: 4.4.1 Ablation of Executor Inputs
blocks.zh: 4.4.1 执行人投入的计算

blocks.en: We first explore how information is prepared for and supplied to the MFM executor on Real-Paired-200. The settings vary depending on the user request, image-specific diagnosis, auxiliary-tool evidence, and whether that evidence is supplied as visual outputs or expressed in text. We use executor inputs to refer to this information; the LQ image is provided in every setting. To isolate their effects, all variants use a single execution round, without verification and re-execution. Tab. 4 compares five settings. In the baseline, the executor receives only the LQ image x x and the user’s request r r . Detailed User Request replaces the short request with a more explicit paragraph that a user could plausibly provide, but adds no image-specific analysis. Single-VLM Instruction uses one VLM to diagnose the image and compose the instruction without using any auxiliary tools. The final two settings follow HarnessIR’s use of separate VLM stages and auxiliary tools. In Visual Evidence , the executor also receives the tools’ original outputs, including the depth map and semantic segmentation map. In Text Evidence , the relevant evidence is composed into language by the composer, which matches the executor-input setting used by HarnessIR.
blocks.zh: 我们首先探索如何为Real-Paired-200上的MFM执行人准备和提供信息。 设置取决于用户请求,图像特定诊断,辅助工具证据,以及该证据是作为视觉输出提供还是以文字表达. 我们使用执行器输入来引用这些信息;每个设置都提供 LQ 图像. 为了孤立其效果,所有变体都使用一发一发的行刑回合,不进行核查并重新执行. Tab. 4比较了五个设置. 在基线中,执行器只接收 LQ 图像 x x 和用户请求 r r 。 详细用户请求将短请求取而代之的是更清晰的段落,用户可以合理提供,但并未添加图像特定分析. 单倍径 指令使用一VLM来诊断图像并作成指令而不用任何辅助工具. 最后一个两个设置是哈内斯IR使用单独的VLM相和辅助工具. 在视觉证据中,执行器还接收工具的原始输出,包括深度图和语义分解图. 在"文本证据"中,相关证据由作曲者组成语言,与HarnesIR使用的执行者-输入设置相匹配.

blocks.en: Table 4: Ablation of executor inputs on Real-Paired-200. All variants use one execution round, without re-execution to isolate the effect of how information is supplied to the executor. The bold row uses the executor-input setting adopted by HarnessIR. Metrics follow Tab. 1 ; the best and second-best results in each column are marked in red and blue .
blocks.zh: 表4:Real-Paired-200上执行人投入的金额。 所有变体使用一发执行回合,而无需再执行来隔离信息如何提供给执行者的效果. 粗体行使用由HarnessIR采用的执行器-输入设置. 度量衡跟随 Tab. 1 ;每列中最佳和次佳结果以红色和蓝色标出.

blocks.en: The results show a steady improvement as progressively more information is supplied to the executor. Expanding the user request alone raises PSNR from 23.94 23.94 to 24.75 24.75 dB and DF-Score from 52.9 52.9 to 54.5 54.5 . Image-specific analysis by a single VLM further increases the DF-Score to 56.6 56.6 . Adding auxiliary tools yields further gains, particularly in degradation removal: the visual-evidence setting achieves a D-Score of 74.4 74.4 and a DF-Score of 57.8 57.8 . However, giving the executor visual maps directly can introduce artifacts, such as semantic-label colors appearing in the restored image. Expressing the relevant evidence in text avoids this risk and suits the executor’s language-based interface. This setting achieves the strongest one-round result, with a PSNR of 26.01 26.01 dB and a DF-Score of 59.6 59.6 . Overall, the results suggest that richer requests, image-specific analysis, auxiliary evidence, and evidence-grounded instruction writing each contribute to better restoration and content preservation.
blocks.zh: 结果表明,随着向执行人提供更多信息的逐步增加,情况稳步改善。 仅扩大用户请求就将PSNR从23.94 23.94提高到24.75 24.75 dB和DF-Score从52.9 52.9提高到54.5 54.5 . 由单个VLM进行图像特异性分析,将DF-Score进一步增加到56.6 56.6. 增加辅助工具可产生进一步收益,特别是在去除退化方面:视觉证据设定的D-S分数为74.4 74.4分,DF-S分数为57.8 57.8分。 然而,直接给予执行者视觉图可以引入文物,如在被恢复的图像中出现的语义-标签颜色. 在文本中表示有关证据可以避免这种风险,并适合执行人的语言界面。 这一设定实现了最强的一回合制结果,PSNR为26.01 26.01 dB,DF-Score为59.6 59.6. 总体而言,结果表明,更丰富的请求、图像特定分析、辅助证据和循证指令书写都有助于更好地恢复和保存内容。

blocks.en: These gains require only a modest increase in inference cost. As shown in Tab. 7 , adding one VLM call raises the cost from $ 0.070 \$0.070 for direct MFM usage to $ 0.077 \$0.077 . Using two VLM calls and auxiliary tools costs $ 0.085 \$0.085 . Thus, the improvements are achieved without a prohibitively expensive control loop, offering a favorable trade-off between restoration quality and cost.
blocks.zh: 这些收益只需要略微地增加推论费用。 如塔布所显示. 7,加上一次VLM呼叫,将直接使用MFM的费用从0.070美元\0.070美元提高到0.077美元\0.077美元. 使用两个VLM电话和辅助工具的费用为0.085美元=0.085美元。 因此,在改进时没有高得令人望而却步的控制循环,在恢复质量与成本之间作出有利的权衡。

blocks.en: 4.4.2 Redo vs. In-place Repair During Re-execution
blocks.zh: 4.4.2 重新执行期间重修与就地修理

blocks.en: We compare two refinement strategies with the single-pass version in Tab. 5 . HarnessIR (Single-pass) performs one execution without re-execution and serves as the reference setting. HarnessIR (In-place refinement) feeds the output of the previous execution back to the executor for further correction, following the sequential refinement strategy of previous agent IR works [ 15 , 30 ] . In contrast, HarnessIR (Redo from LQ) returns to the original LQ image when refinement is triggered, composes a revised instruction, and generates a new candidate from scratch, which corresponds to the final HarnessIR design described in Sec. 3.4 .
blocks.zh: 我们比较了两个改进策略和Tab的单通版本. 5. HarnessIR (Single-pass) 执行一次而无需重新执行,并作为参考设定. HarnesIR (In-place definition) 将前一次执行的输出反馈给执行者,以进一步校正,遵循前代理IR作品的相继改进策略[15,30]. 相形之下,HarnessIR(Redo from LQ)在被触发后返回到最初的LQ图像上,编写修改后的指示,并从零开始产生新的候选,这与Sec.3.4所描述的最终HarnessIR设计相对应.

blocks.en: Table 5: Ablation of refinement strategies on Real-Paired-200. We compare three settings: HarnessIR (Single-pass) , which performs a single MFM execution without re-execution; HarnessIR (In-place refinement) , which applies a revised instruction to the output of the previous round; and HarnessIR (Redo from LQ) which applies a revised instruction to original LQ input. Metrics follow Tab. 1 , the best and second-best results are marked in red and blue .
blocks.zh: 表5:关于《Real-Paired-200》的完善战略的说明。 我们比较了三种设置:HarnessIR(Single-pass),它执行单一的MFM执行而无需重新执行;HarnessIR(In-place definition),它应用了修改后的指示来完成上一轮的输出;HarnessIR(Redo from LQ),它应用修改后的指示来完成原始的LQ输入. 量子跟随 Tab. 1, 最佳和次好的结果以红色和蓝色标出.

blocks.en: The results support restarting from the original input rather than refining an already altered image. In-place refinement is inferior even to the single-pass setting, with the DF-Score decreasing from 59.6 59.6 to 57.2 57.2 . In contrast, redo from the LQ input improves PSNR from 26.01 26.01 to 26.63 26.63 dB and raises the D-Score/F-Score from 73.0 73.0 / 58.5 58.5 to 75.2 75.2 / 63.6 63.6 , resulting in a DF-Score of 62.0 62.0 . This suggests that an unsuccessful intermediate result may contain hallucinated or distorted content that should not be propagated into the next round. Restarting from the LQ input allows the revised instruction to correct the failure without accumulating errors. Importantly, this improvement is not uniform across all samples: only 37 % 37\% of the 200 test images undergo re-execution, and the gains come from this subset. Images that already produce satisfactory results in the first round remain unchanged. Thus, redo primarily repairs difficult tail cases rather than improving every image uniformly. Detailed statistics on the re-execution frequency and its associated cost are provided in Sec. 4.5 .
blocks.zh: 结果支持从原始输入重新开始,而不是改进已经被改变的图像。 实地改进甚至低于单行道设置,DF-Score从59.6 59.6下降到57.2 57.2。 相形之下,从LQ输入的再做将PSNR从26.01 26.01提高到26.63 26.63 dB,将D-Score/F-Score从73.0 73.0 / 58.5 58.5提高到75.2 75.2 / 63.6 63.6,导致DF-Score 62.0 62.0. 这表明,不成功的中间结果可能含有幻觉或扭曲的内容,不应传播到下一轮。 从 LQ 输入中恢复,允许修改后的指示在不积累错误的情况下纠正失败. 重要的是,这种改进并非在所有样本中都是统一的:200个测试图像中只有37%的37.%得到重新执行,收益来自这一子集。 第一轮已经产生令人满意的结果的图像保持不变。 因此,重做主要是修理困难的尾箱,而不是统一改善每个图像。 关于重新执行频率及其相关费用的详细统计数据载于第4.5节。

blocks.en: 4.4.3 VLM Choice
blocks.zh: 4.4.3 VLM (英语). 选择

blocks.en: We compare different VLMs for HarnessIR’s diagnoser and composer on Real-Paired-200. Verification-driven re-execution is disabled in all variants, allowing us to compare the VLMs without gains from additional execution rounds.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了哈内斯IR的诊断者和作曲者关于Real-Paired-200的不同VLM. 核查驱动的再执行在所有变体中被禁用,使我们能够比较VLM,而不从额外的执行回合中获得收益.

blocks.en: As shown in Tab. 6 , the results suggest that HarnessIR does not depend on a specific VLM, provided the model is sufficiently capable. The locally deployed Qwen3-VL-32B performs somewhat worse, reaching a DF-Score of 57.5 57.5 . GPT-5.6-Luna and Gemini-3.7-Flash perform similarly, with DF-Scores of 59.1 59.1 and 59.6 59.6 , respectively. GPT-5.6-Sol achieves the highest PSNR and DF-scores, but its gains over Gemini-3.7-Flash are modest: 0.17 0.17 dB in PSNR and 0.9 0.9 points in DF-Score. We therefore use Gemini-3.7-Flash in the final system: its restoration performance is comparable, while GPT-5.6-Sol incurs substantially higher API cost (see Sec. 4.5 ).
blocks.zh: 如塔布所显示. 6,结果显示哈内斯IR并不依赖于特定的VLM,只要该模型具有足够的能力. 当地部署的Qwen3-VL-32B性能稍差,达到DF-Score57.5 57.5. GPT-5.6-Luna和双子座-3.7-Flash性能相类似,DF-Score分数分别为59.1 59.1和59.6 59.6.6. GPT-5.6-Sol实现最高的PSNR和DF-分数,但其在双子座-3.7-Flash上的得分不高:PSNR为0.170.17分,DF-分数为0.9分. 因此,我们在最终系统中使用双子座-3.7-Flash:它的还原性能是相当的,而GPT-5.6-Sol的API成本要高得多(见Sec 4.5)。

blocks.en: Table 6: Effect of the VLMs used for diagnoser and composer on Real-Paired-200. Verification-driven re-execution is disabled in all variants. Metrics follow Tab. 1 ; the best and second-best results in each column are marked in red and blue .
blocks.zh: 表6:用于诊断和作曲的VLM对Real-Paired-200的影响。 在所有变体中禁用由验证驱动的再执行. 度量衡跟随 Tab. 1 ;每列中最佳和次佳结果以红色和蓝色标出.

blocks.en: 4.5 Cost Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.5 成本分析

blocks.en: Table 7: Average per-image runtime, call counts, restoration performance, and cost on Real-Paired-200. VLM and MFM denote API calls. Tool / Perception: Tool reports local model used as restoration or auxiliary tools, perception reports local VLM model used for perception.
blocks.zh: 表7: 平均每个图像运行时间、电话数、恢复性能以及Real-Paired-200的费用。 VLM和MFM表示API呼叫. 工具/概念 : 工具报告用作还原或辅助工具的本地模型,感知报告用于感知的本地VLM模型.

blocks.en: As shown in Tab. 7 , we report the per-image runtime, call counts, restoration performance, and cost of different HarnessIR variants and two previous agentic IR methods [ 15 , 16 ] on Real-Paired-200. Runtime and VLM call counts come from actual runs. For local computation, including the prior methods’ functional modules and HarnessIR’s auxiliary tools, we convert measured runtime into cost using on-demand A100 GPU rental rates; API costs are estimated from observed token usage and public list prices. We exclude costs that are difficult to assign to individual images, such as parallel waiting, environment setup, and deployment overhead. Rental rates provide the fairest method-independent basis for comparison, whereas GPU purchase costs depend on assumptions about depreciation, utilization, service lifetime, and allocation, making per-image costs ill-defined and incomparable. The resulting values should therefore be viewed as idealized references for computational and monetary efficiency. We discuss the results first and detail the calculations afterward.
blocks.zh: 如塔布所显示. 7,我们在Real-Paired-200上报告了每个图像运行时间,呼叫计数,恢复性能,以及不同的HarneshIR变体和前两种代理IR方法的成本. 运行时间和VLM呼叫计数来自实际运行. 就当地计算而言,包括先前方法的功能模块和HarnessIR的辅助工具,我们使用按需的A100 GPU租赁费率将所计量的运行时间转换为成本; API费用是根据观察到的象征性使用和公共清单价格估算的。 我们排除了个别图像难以分配的费用,例如平行等待、环境设置和部署费用。 租金为比较提供了最公平的独立方法基础,而全球采购单位的购买费用则取决于折旧、利用率、服务寿命和分配方面的假设,使每个图像的成本定义不清且不可比较。 因此,由此产生的数值应被视为计算和货币效率的理想化参考。 我们首先讨论结果,然后详细说明计算结果。

blocks.en: Results Analysis. Compared with the two previous agentic IR methods, the final HarnessIR system achieves a higher DF-Score on Real-Paired-200 at a lower estimated per-image cost: $ 0.129 \$0.129 , compared with $ 0.137 \$0.137 for AgenticIR and $ 0.190 \$0.190 for 4KAgent. For the HarnessIR variants, starting from direct MFM usage, adding a single VLM call raises the DF-Score from 52.9 52.9 to 56.6 56.6 and the PSNR from 23.94 23.94 to 25.49 25.49 dB, while increasing the cost only from $ 0.070 \$0.070 to $ 0.077 \$0.077 per image. This one-call variant requires no local GPU computation, making it a particularly attractive option when simplicity and deployment cost are priorities. Adding a second VLM call and local auxiliary tools raises the cost modestly to $ 0.085 \$0.085 , while further improving the DF-Score to 59.6 59.6 and the PSNR to 26.01 26.01 dB. Thus, the diagnosis-and-composition pipeline provides a favorable additional quality gain for a small increase in cost.
blocks.zh: 成果分析。 与前两种代理IR方法相比,最终的HarnesIR系统在Real-Paired-200上实现了较高的DF-Score,每幅图像的估计成本较低:0.129美元为0.129美元,而代理IR为0.137美元;而4KAgent为0.190美元. 对于哈内斯IR变体,从直接使用MFM开始,增加一个单VLM调用,将DF-Score从52.9 52.9提高到56.6 56.6,PSNR从23.94 23.94提高到25.49 25.49 dB,而成本仅从0.070美元\0.070美元提高到0.077\0.077美元. 这种一次性调用变式不需要当地GPU计算,使它在简便和部署费用成为优先事项时成为一个特别有吸引力的选择. 加上第二次VLM呼叫和当地辅助工具,成本微调为0.085 \ 0.085美元,同时将DF-Score进一步提高至59.6 59.6分,PSNR提高到 26.01 26.01 dB. 因此,诊断和组合管道为成本小幅增加提供了有利的额外质量收益。

blocks.en: The complete HarnessIR system adds verification and selective re-execution, reaching a DF-Score of 62.0 62.0 and a PSNR of 26.63 26.63 dB at an average cost of $ 0.129 \$0.129 per image. This average gain is driven by the subset of difficult cases that trigger re-execution rather than by uniformly improving every image: 37% of images undergo at least one redo, and the verifier retains the better candidate. The increased cost, therefore, supports targeted correction of cases that need it. We conduct a user study to compare restoration quality on real images.
For each test case, annotators see one low-quality (LQ) image together with the eight restorations of that image. The eight methods are the same set used in the DF-Score comparison: PromptIR [ 10 ] , InstructIR [ 27 ] , 4KAgent [ 16 ] , AgenticIR [ 15 ] , GPT-Image 2.5 [ 18 ] , Nano Banana 2 [ 17 ] , HarnessIR-GPT and HarnessIR-NB2. The eight results are shown in random order. Method names and metric values are withheld as well. Annotators are required to select the single restoration they judge to be the best. The instruction asks them to prefer a result that removes the target degradation, preserves the main scene content, and avoids obvious artifacts.

blocks.en: 5  Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented HarnessIR , an agentic framework that used MFMs as the executor for universal real-world IR. By combining image-specific diagnosis, auxiliary tools, prompt composition, and verification-driven re-execution, HarnessIR harnessed the MFM to remove degradations without altering image content. Across synthetic and challenging real-world benchmarks, HarnessIR consistently improved restoration performance over the direct use of MFM, achieving particularly large gains on real-world images. Our ablations further showed that these improvements came from the coordinated design of the harness at an acceptable cost. Overall, HarnessIR demonstrated that a carefully designed harness can substantially unlock the restoration potential of proper MFMs and turn them into more effective and controllable universal real-world restorers.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍了HarnessIR, 这个代理框架使用MFM作为普遍现实世界IR的执行者。 通过结合图像特异性的诊断,辅助工具,即时成份,以及验证驱动的再执行,HarnesIR利用了MFM来去除降解而不会改变图像内容. 在整个合成和具有挑战性的现实世界基准中,HarnessIR比直接使用MFM不断提高恢复性能,在现实世界的图像上取得了特别大的成果. 我们的炮火进一步表明,这些改进来自以可接受的成本协调地设计了这台吊带。 总体而言,HarnessIR表明,精心设计的管带可以大大地释放出适当的MFM的还原潜力,并将其转化为更有效和可控制的通用现实世界还原器.

blocks.en: Limitations. HarnessIR requires access to online VLM and MFM APIs, which is a common requirement by existing agentic IR methods such as AgenticIR [ 15 ] and 4KAgent [ 16 ] (using GPT-4o). Moreover, an agentic harness can only elicit and regulate the capabilities of its executor but cannot raise the executor’s performance ceiling. In the future, with this general IR agent, we can curate diverse and challenging restoration data and generate verification-guided training supervision to improve the capabilities of local and smaller models.
blocks.zh: 限制。 节奏 IR要求访问在线VLM和MFM API,这是AgenticIR [15]和4KAgent [16](使用GPT-4o)等现有代理IR方法的共同要求. 此外,一种代理手段只能诱导和调节其执行者的能力,但不能提高执行者的性能上限。 今后,有了这种一般的IR剂,我们就能整理出多样而有挑战性的修复数据,并产生核查指导的培训监督,来提高本地和较小模型的能力.

blocks.en: Appendix C DF-Score Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: 附录C DF-Score评价议定书

blocks.en: This section describes the evaluation protocol and reliability analysis of DF-Score. First, since the system prompt used by the independent VLM evaluator to assign D-Score and F-Score is several pages long, we provide it in released codes. We then assess the alignment of DF-Score and representative no-reference IQA metrics with human judgments through a pairwise study. Finally, we test whether D-Score, F-Score, and DF-Score remain consistent across VLM evaluators from different model families.
blocks.zh: 本节介绍DF-Score的评价协议和可靠性分析. 首先,由于独立VLM评价员用来指定D-Score和F-Score的系统是多页长的,所以我们在发布的代码中提供了它. 然后,我们通过双向研究,评估DF-Score和具有代表性的IQA衡量标准与人类判断的一致性。 最后,我们测试D-Score、F-Score和DF-Score在来自不同模式家庭的VLM评价人员中是否保持一致性。

blocks.en: Alignment with Human Judgments. We evaluate how well DF-Score and commonly used NR-IQA metrics agree with human judgments of restoration quality. We construct 300 comparison pairs from the Real-NoGT-200 test set. Each pair contains one LQ image and two restorations of that image produced by distinct methods. The method pool includes PromptIR [ 10 ] , InstructIR [ 27 ] , 4KAgent [ 16 ] , AgenticIR [ 15 ] , GPT-Image 2.5 [ 18 ] , Nano Banana 2 [ 17 ] , HarnessIR-GPT, and HarnessIR-NB2. For each pair, two methods are sampled uniformly from this pool. The left–right order of the restorations is randomized, and method identities and metric scores are hidden from the annotators.
blocks.zh: 符合人类的判断 我们评价DF-Score和常用的NR-IQA衡量标准如何与人类对恢复质量的判断一致。 我们从Real-NoGT-200测试机组制造出300个比较对. 每对都包含一个LQ图像和两个由不同方法产生的图像修复. 方法池包括"快活"[10],"教程"[27],"4KAgent"[16],"AgenticIR"[15],"GPT-Image 2.5 [18]","纳诺香蕉"[17],"哈内斯IR-GPT"和"哈内斯IR-NB2". 对于每对,从这个池中统一抽取出两种方法. 修复的左-右顺序是随机的,方法身份和度量分数被隐藏在注释者身上.

blocks.en: We recruit 30 30 annotators. For each pair, annotators are shown the LQ image together with the two restorations and asked to select the better result. The instructions emphasize that a preferable restoration should remove the target degradation, preserve the content and structure of the input image, and avoid visible artifacts. Each annotator provides one forced-choice judgment per pair.
blocks.zh: 我们招募了30名注释员 对于每对,注释器会连同两个修复图一起显示LQ图像并被要求选择更好的结果. 说明中强调,较好的修复应去除目标退化,保存输入图像的内容和结构,并避免可见文物. 每个注释员每对给出一个强制选择判断.

blocks.en: We aggregate the annotations by majority vote to obtain the human preference for each pair. Pairs without a strict majority are discarded. For a metric m m , we measure its agreement with human judgments using the alignment ratio: Align ⁡ ( m ) = # ​ { valid pairs whose metric ordering agrees with the majority vote } # ​ { valid pairs } . \mathrm{Align}(m)=\frac{\#\{\text{valid pairs whose metric ordering agrees with the majority vote}\}}{\#\{\text{valid pairs}\}}. A random ranking gives an expected alignment of 50 % 50\% . We report the alignment of DF-Score and four representative NR-IQA metrics—MUSIQ, AFINE-NR, TOPIQ, and MANIQA—in Fig. C.2 . DF-Score agrees with human preference in 87 % 87\% of valid comparisons, whereas the NR-IQA metrics achieve lower alignment rates, ranging from 50.8 % 50.8\% to 67.1 % 67.1\% . This suggests that, when ground-truth images are unavailable, DF-Score may better reflect human preferences than the NR-IQA metrics.

blocks.en: Consistency Across Evaluator Families. We examine whether D-Score, F-Score, and their geometric mean, DF-Score, depend strongly on the choice of VLM evaluator. Using the restored outputs for the 400 images in Real-Paired-200 and Real-NoGT-200, we obtain scores from GPT-5.6-Sol and Claude-Opus-5 under the same evaluation protocol and compute the Pearson linear correlation coefficient (PLCC) between each evaluator’s scores and those of Gemini-3.7-Flash. Tab. C.2 reports the correlations for all three scores. Despite the presence of some outliers, the correlations are consistently high across all three measures, ranging from 0.85 0.85 to 0.94 0.94 . This result suggests that DF-Score is robust to the choice of VLM evaluator. Assessing whether degradations have been removed and whether the original image content has been preserved is comparatively straightforward, and different VLMs appear capable of making these judgments consistently, even though their absolute scores may differ.

blocks.en: Tab. D.3 shows the detailed quantitative results for each group of MiO100. Restoration becomes more challenging as the simulated degradations become more complex. Each of Groups A and B combines two degradations, while Group C combines three, resulting in more severe and interacting distortions. Accordingly, most methods show lower PSNR, SSIM, and DF-Score for Group C. For example, when using Nano Banana 2 directly, the DF-Score falls from 61.75 61.75 in Group A and 61.00 61.00 in Group B to 44.85 44.85 in Group C.

blocks.en: To further demonstrate the visual quality of HarnessIR, Fig. E.3 presents additional comparisons on the three test sets. Compared with direct MFM usage, HarnessIR restores facial details more faithfully and maintains a consistent color appearance, as illustrated by the first and fifth examples. It also recovers text while avoiding the spatial shifts and content changes observed in the direct MFM results, particularly in the second and third examples. For rainy and snowy scenes, HarnessIR removes the rain or snow that obstructs visibility while preserving the structure and appearance of other scene elements. For instance, it does not alter the shape of trees or hallucinate leaves in the fourth example of Fig. E.3 .
blocks.zh: 进一步展示哈内斯IR,Fig的视觉品质. E.3对这三套测试进行了更多的比较。 与直接的MFM用法相比,HarnesIR更忠实地恢复了面部细节并保持了一致的颜色外观,第一和第五例说明了这一点. 它还恢复了文字,同时避免了在直接的MFM结果中观察到的空间变化和内容变化,特别是在第二和第三个例子中. 对于多雨多雪的场景,HarnessIR在保留其他场景元素的结构和外观的同时去除会阻碍能见度的雨或雪. 例如,它在"Fig"的第四例中没有改变树的形状或幻觉叶. E.3 (中文(简体) ).

blocks.en: The comparisons also reveal several limitations of previous methods on real-world images. Existing all-in-one and agentic methods often provide only a limited visible improvement on such inputs. InstructIR frequently brightens scenes even when low-light enhancement is not requested, as shown in the third and fifth examples. 4KAgent also suffers from a severe failure in the third example, producing a substantially corrupted result. This behavior illustrates a limitation of sequentially applying single-degradation restoration models: processing one degradation can change the distribution of the remaining degradations, causing the next model in the sequence to encounter an out-of-distribution input and fail. HarnessIR avoids this error-propagation problem by handling mixed degradations in a unified MFM execution while applying a redo refinement strategy.
blocks.zh: 比较还揭示出以往方法对现实世界图像的几个局限性. 现有的全方位和代理方法往往只能对此类投入提供有限的明显改进。 指示tIR即使不要求低光增强也经常会使场景亮出,如第三和第五例所示. 4KAgent公司在第三个例子中也遭受了严重的失败,造成了严重腐败的结果。 这种行为说明了相继应用的单降解还原模型的局限性:处理一个降解可以改变剩余降解的分布,导致序列中的下个模型会遇到分流外输入而失败. 节奏 IR通过在统一的MFM执行中处理混合降解,同时应用重做改进策略来避免了这个错误传播问题.
